d:
Short, wispy platinum white hair and a long, thin white beard. Narrowed, clouded pale grey eyes with a weathered, elderly expression. A frail, elderly appearance with deep wrinkles and sagging skin. A small, slender frame. A simple, coarse off-white linen robe tied with a hempen cord. A weathered wooden staff held in a gnarled hand.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
